verdict.rationale: smolagents is an open-source Python library that runs any LLM (local transformers/ollama or via LiteLLM) and executes locally or in self-hosted sandboxes (Docker, E2B, Modal, Blaxel), with no required dependency on a vendor platform — Hub sharing is optional. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on report explicitly confirming a fully air-gapped self-hosted deployment end-to-end, and CLI/local execution details are docs-only.
